request.style: English, ancient Middle Eastern love song duet, a man's and a woman's voice answering each other, oud, qanun, ney flute and soft frame drum, Maqam Bayati, warm and tender, 6/8, 88 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The voice of my beloved, look, he comes
Leaping over the mountains, bounding over the hills
My beloved speaks and says to me
Arise, my love, my beautiful one, and come away

[Chorus]
For behold, the winter is past
The rain is over and gone
The flowers appear on the earth
The time of singing has come

[Verse]
The fig tree ripens its figs
The vines are in blossom, they give their fragrance
Arise, my love, my beautiful one
And come away

[Chorus]
For behold, the winter is past
The rain is over and gone
The flowers appear on the earth
The time of singing has come
